vocabulary.definition: a feeling that makes one self-conscious and unable to act in a relaxed and natural way
vocabulary.example: After a few drinks, she lost her inhibitions and started dancing on the table.

vocabulary.definition: the process of removing toxic substances from the body
vocabulary.example: She went on a detox diet to cleanse her body and improve her health.

vocabulary.definition: chemical messengers that transmit signals between neurons in the brain
vocabulary.example: Serotonin and dopamine are examples of neurotransmitters that play a role in mood regulation.

vocabulary.definition: a late stage of scarring (fibrosis) of the liver caused by many forms of liver diseases and conditions
vocabulary.example: His excessive alcohol consumption led to the development of cirrhosis, a serious liver condition.

vocabulary.definition: unwilling or unable to associate in a normal or friendly way with other people
vocabulary.example: He displayed antisocial behavior, avoiding social gatherings and interactions with colleagues.

vocabulary.definition: a state of relying on or being controlled by something or someone else
vocabulary.example: Over time, his dependence on alcohol became so strong that he couldn't function without it.
